notes:
Summary: Skyline is a mid-market ecommerce platform (marketplaces + direct D2C stores). Looking to replace slow manual triage with automated agent assist + tool-calls into ServiceNow/Zendesk and payments gateway for refunds. Open to private deployment for PII/payment data isolation; cost-conscious but prioritizes reliability during promotions.

Reps: AE Ava Patel, SE Noah Garcia engaged. CSM Priya shadowing in evaluation. POC started 2025-07-15.

Key technical needs / asks:
- Tool-calling workflows: create/update tickets, set priority, attach transcripts, initiate refunds via payment API (Stripe/Gateway-Adapter) with idempotency guarantees.
- Escalation hooks: PagerDuty/SMS for high-severity SLA breaches, multi-step runbooks.
- Latency & spikes: need predictable tail latency during Black-Friday-like traffic spikes; want autoscaling/fallback to cheaper model under load but with safe rollback.
- Security: VPC private control plane, KMS integration for keys, audit logs retained 1 year, SSO/SAML integration.
- Data handling: redact PI from transcripts before storage; support configurable retention windows.

What we heard on calls:
- "Agent suggestions must be instantaneous — anything >250ms will be disruptive to CS flow." — Head of Support (K. Moreno)
- Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations to reduce token cost for high-volume summarization.
- Wants ability to test model fallbacks in a canary before full traffic routing.

POC specifics:
- Scope: 6-week POC to validate tool-calling into ServiceNow sandbox, refund flow into Stripe test account, and load test to 6k req/min for 20 minutes.
- Success metrics: accuracy of ticket classification >92%, average agent-suggestion latency <=250ms, refund automation success >=99% (idempotent), error rate under spikes <0.5%.

Risks flagged by internal: legal needs to confirm permissions for automated refunds; payments team to sign off on idempotent refund pattern. Security review requested SOC2 Type II artifacts and pen test report.

Stubs & refs: demo recording (drive link), security FAQ (drive link), Fireflies transcripts attached. Jira: created SUP-1182 for ServiceNow connectors.

Next conversation: technical run-through of ServiceNow API mapping + identify required connector credentials (scheduled 2025-08-20).
